Shiori 1.1.0 – Your Library, Your Choice! 🔒☁️

✨ What's New

  • Choose Where Your Library Lives: Keep your bookmarks in Shiori Cloud, only on this Mac, or in your own iCloud account synced between your Macs!
  • Move Your Library Safely: A guided move from Shiori Cloud to this Mac or iCloud copies everything, checks the copy, and leaves your cloud library untouched!
  • One Location for Every Mac: Shiori remembers the location chosen for your account, so every Mac you sign in on uses the same one!
  • Folder Images: Choose, replace or remove an image for any folder, and it goes wherever your folder goes!
  • AI Assistants: Connect local AI assistants in Settings → AI Assistants to work with your bookmarks, tags and folders. Read-only by default, and every change asks for your OK!
  • Backup & Recovery: Export a full backup of your library and merge libraries from different Macs only when you choose!

🚀 Improvements

  • Safer Sign-In: Confirm the account before you continue, or switch to a different one!
  • Faster Start: Your saved bookmarks open right away while your sign-in is checked in the background!
  • Browser Extensions: The Chrome, Safari and Firefox extensions can use the library stored on your Mac!

🐞 Bug Fixes

  • Windows Back on Screen: Windows left off-screen (for example after unplugging a display) now come back where you can reach them!

Thank you for being part of the Shiori community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
